tools.name: list_filers
tools.description: Free. Call first: the current coverage list (SEC filers, central banks, US macro and CPI ids, bundles) with prices, payTo, card dates and content hashes. Compact by default (ids, prices, as_of, content_hash); pass full: true for the whole /catalog. Tickers: AMD, MRVL, NVDA, AVGO, TSM, MU, AMAT, AAPL

tools.name: search_coverage
tools.description: Free: find a covered company, central bank or US macro release by name or topic. Returns the tool to call. Missing? Use request_data.

tools.name: whats_new
tools.description: Free: cards changed since a date, each with a one-line headline (name, card date, next update) and content_hash so you skip re-buying unchanged cards. Missing coverage? Use request_data.

tools.description: Free sample US macro card (CPI, payrolls, GDP): a trimmed view of the latest card (comparison_basis says how many items), same schema as get_macro, no payment. Macro ids: NFP, GDP, CPI.

tools.name: get_filing_delta
tools.description: Paid $0.05 USDC on Base. Call when you need what changed in a company's latest SEC filing (10-Q, 10-K, 8-K or 6-K) vs the prior period, not the headline: each change cited to EDGAR with a materiality rating and why it matters. Free: sample_delta. Tickers: AMD, MRVL, NVDA, AVGO, TSM, MU, AMAT, AAPL,

tools.name: request_data
tools.description: Free: ask for a ticker, bank or release we lack. what required (500 chars max), no links/HTML. Limit 5/hour, 20/wallet/day. Returns ok.

tools.name: get_macro

tools.name: get_cpi
tools.description: Paid $0.05 USDC on Base. Free: sample_macro id CPI (US). CPI ids: US, UK, EA, JP. Others return 404 (no charge).
